review.summary: Fixes 1–3 look resolved in the supplied page helper, card and test lines. Fix 1: when the report is not ready, every card shows only the value 尚不可計算 with no cause text, and the section state message explains the real state. The no-report test still checks that all 5 cards are unavailable with no numbers. The ready missing_data test now checks for the original cause text. Fix 2: the new tests check that unexpected errors from the candidate read and the ready-report read are passed through (rejects.toBe), and that the 5 malformed available-metric cases show 尚不可計算 and 報表資料尚待確認. I checked each case against the guard in metricDisplay. Fix 3: the comment is corrected. Authorization, candidate binding and the expiry/revision reader are unchanged in the supplied text. No blocker or major issue found. Two non-blocking gaps remain. MINOR: inside a ready report, metricDisplay still shows the hard-coded cause for any metric that is not available and not a zero denominator. That includes a missing metric entry, an unknown status, and an unavailable or not_applicable metric with a reason other than missing_data. In those cases the page states a guessed cause instead of the invalid-data message. NIT: the no-report and unready tests check that only 2 of the 5 cause texts are absent. Per the brief, tsc is still rerunning and WP20 remains NOT_READY; an empty or non-blocking findings list does not certify tests or release.

findings.area: metricDisplay: `if (metric.status !== 'available') return { value: '尚不可計算', reason: missingReason };`
findings.issue: In a ready report, the hard-coded cause for a metric is shown for any status other than available or not_applicable/zero_denominator. That includes a missing metric key (record() returns {}), an unknown status, and an unavailable or not_applicable metric with a reason other than missing_data. These are malformed or unknown report states, but the page shows a specific guessed source cause instead of the 報表資料尚待確認 message that Fix 2 uses for malformed available metrics.
findings.evidence: The status check does not look at metric.reason except for zero_denominator. For example, a missing registrationRate key yields status undefined, so the page shows 缺少報名頁的不重複訪客數…. The tests only cover reason 'missing_data' for the cause text.
findings.impact: In an edge case, the page can show a misleading cause for why a metric is unavailable. No numbers are wrong and no stale data is shown, so this does not block.
findings.recommended_fix: Show missingReason only when status === 'unavailable' && reason === 'missing_data'. For every other non-available status or reason, return { value: '尚不可計算', reason: '報表資料尚待確認。' }.
findings.required_test: In page.test.tsx, set up a ready report where registrationRate is absent, then {status:'unavailable',reason:'other'}, then {status:'bogus'}. Assert that the card shows 尚不可計算 and 報表資料尚待確認, and does not contain 不重複訪客數.

findings.area: no-report it.each and the queued/running/failed/stale it.each
findings.issue: The tests that check no guessed cause is shown only check that 2 of the 5 cause texts are absent (不重複訪客數, and 完成觀看與同一位觀眾 in the no-report case only). The attendance, completion and average-viewing cause texts are never checked.
findings.evidence: expect(section).not.toContain("不重複訪客數"); expect(section).not.toContain("完成觀看與同一位觀眾"); the queued/running/failed/stale cases check only '不重複訪客數'.
findings.impact: If one of the other three cause texts came back on unready cards, the tests would not catch it. Behavior is correct today because the page uses reason ''.
findings.recommended_fix: Loop over coreMetricDefinitions' reason strings, or a duplicated fixed list, and assert that none appears when the state is not ready.
findings.required_test: Same tests, with a not.toContain assertion for all 5 cause strings.
